_about: American Tycoon civilization content, v2 DRAFT: the original 6 civilizations (tiers 1-6, unchanged except rosters extended to cover the 100 new properties) plus 20 NEW alien civilizations (tiers 7-26) for review. American Tycoon is an idle/tycoon game: you build a property empire in Earth dollars, and 'consume' each epoch's economy to make First Contact with the next civilization (a bigger market). The single currency stays dollars; each civ's currency is FLAVOR only.

civilizations.contact_line: Beings of living light, and they still noticed your money first. Everything moves at lightspeed here. Including mistakes.
civilizations.hail: Your little sun is charming. We measured your fortune the moment it crossed the void — such a lovely flicker. Come. Shine with us.

civilizations.contact_line: Machines that never sleep, never quit, never ask why. Your money just stopped asking, too.
civilizations.hail: HANDSHAKE ACCEPTED. ASSETS: CATALOGUED. OWNER: DESIGNATED ‘THE VARIABLE.’ SENTIMENT: NOT FOUND. COMMENCING COMMERCE.

civilizations.contact_line: Money that grows itself, branching through the dark, feeding on everything it touches. Best not to ask what it eats.
civilizations.hail: we felt you buying… through the roots… through the dark… everything joins the network, eventually… grow with us… grow…

civilizations.contact_line: Wealth, crystallized. Harder than diamond, and exactly as warm.
civilizations.hail: Appraisal complete. Your empire is… adequate. Inclusions detected. We will permit it to be cut, faceted, and polished.

civilizations.contact_line: They sell time itself, by the second — at a markup you will never live long enough to repay.
civilizations.hail: Good afternoon. You have approximately 1.4 billion seconds remaining. Would you care to spend them profitably? Interest accrues… momentarily.

civilizations.contact_line: Seven miles down, where the sun has never held an account, the aristocracy hangs glowing storefronts from their own foreheads. Foot traffic swims right in and is never itemized again.
civilizations.hail: Weeelcome... dooown... little surface-thing... your weeealth siiinks so beautifully. The Deep-Court has appraiiised your empire... by the glow of a thousand luuures... and found it... edible. At these depths... everything... eventually... settles with us.

civilizations.contact_line: Serpents who founded a religion on insurance, then built a civilization on the paperwork. Their embrace is total coverage — in the constrictor sense.
civilizations.hail: Sssalutationsss, sssoft-ssskinned asssset. Our sssensorsss indicate you are — how tragic — entirely uninsssured. Sssign here, and here, and initial here; the sssqueeze you feel is ssimply the coverage taking hold.

civilizations.contact_line: A gilded-age bee aristocracy that turned the hive into a stock exchange and the drones into unpaid interns. The queen annexed your portfolio before you finished bowing.
civilizations.hail: By royal decree, We have tazzted your fortune upon the wind and pronounce it zzweet enough for Court. Your buzzness is hereby annexed to the Hive; your pozzition is Provisional Drone, compensated in exposure to Our radiance. Kneel, and bring nectar.

civilizations.contact_line: Ice giants who compound interest once per ice age and regard a fiscal quarter as an act of violence. Try not to fidget; they can hear it.
civilizations.hail: Hail, hasty little ember. Your wealth-hoard has been weighed and carved upon the ᚠᛖᚺᚢ-stone, where it shall sit unspent for a thousand winters, as is proper. Sit — the thaw-debt comes due for all who rush.

civilizations.contact_line: Beings made entirely of sound, and every note they've ever sung is under copyright. Try not to hum anything — it's licensed.
civilizations.hail: ♪ hush… we heard your fortune humming from across the void, and darling, it was flat ♪ every coin that clinks is a note, and every note is licensed to US ♪ so begin quietly, invest steadily, and TOGETHER WE SHALL CRESCENDO ♪

staffer_roster_all_properties.staffer: Deed-Holder of the Music of the Spheres

civilizations.contact_line: The Umbrafex Syndicate does not officially exist, which is also how they file their taxes. Somehow you already owe them a favor.
civilizations.hail: you did not receive this hail... there is no Syndicate, and it is very pleased with your ledgers... one favor has been extended to you — terms ██████, repayable upon ██████... tell no one. we certainly didn't...

civilizations.contact_line: A mercenary horde that discovered spreadsheets and never looked back. Their invoices arrive by catapult, and they are always paid.
civilizations.hail: KARR'GH! Your treasury has been scouted, vok'tar — the walls are thin and the margins THINNER. Surrender your holdings to the Warhoard and we will call it a MERGER; resist, and we will call it Q4.

civilizations.contact_line: They will apologize for the invoice, the interest, and the repossession — in that order, on monogrammed stationery.
civilizations.hail: How dreadfully kind of you to answer — we do hope the intrusion is not too great a bother. We have taken the small liberty of opening an account in your name; terribly sorry to mention the interest, which began, regrettably, some time ago. Do give our warmest regards to your assets, while they remain yours.

civilizations.contact_line: They have been selling you dreams your whole life, strictly on credit. Last night's invoice is already overdue.
civilizations.hail: you were somewhere warm... a staircase, an empire, your teeth were falling out and every tooth was a coin... lovely, that one. that will be forty thousand REMs... payable before you wake.

staffer_roster_all_properties.staffer: Cold Side of the Pillow Monopolist

civilizations.contact_line: Philologists who devour languages whole and hold clear title to several dead ones. They will correct your grammar, then bill you for the lesson.
civilizations.hail: Ah — you say 'we come in peace,' but you mean 'we come to trade'; do be precise, for precision is λόγος, and λόγος is money. Every syllable you have just spent accrues to our accounts — a modest δραχμή per phoneme, plus a surcharge for that dangling modifier. Speak on, speak on; you grow more indebted with every word.

civilizations.contact_line: They eat metal for a living and file the corrosion as earnings. Here, nothing ever depreciates — it just rusts, at a very competitive rate.
civilizations.hail: Ore-scent confirmed. Your coin-hoard is already rusting, soft-thing — that is not rot, that is interest, and we hold the note. Pay the rust-tithe, sign the ore-debt, and the Guilds will chew you into something profitable.

civilizations.contact_line: They own nothing but opinions, and their opinions are worth more than your entire empire. They have already pronounced it 'derivative.'
civilizations.hail: Ah. The portfolio arrives — bold, busy, très nouveau riche, darling. We shall hang it in the west wing under 'Outsider Art' until your taste appreciates... or until you do, whichever is never.

civilizations.contact_line: They ran the numbers on your arrival and priced it at even money. The house, as always, had already collected.
civilizations.hail: Well, well — look what the wormhole dragged in. We had you nine-to-two to show up broke, friend, and the house never loses, so go ahead and check your pockets. Pull up a chair; the drinks are free, the table is honest-ish, and the odds of you leaving richer are — let's call them ours.

civilizations.contact_line: Beings of pure reflection who sold you a copy of yourself before you finished waving. The royalties on your own face are already past due.
civilizations.hail: ɘmoɔlɘW. Welcome — you say it, we say it back, and the saying-back is billable. You built an empire; an empire built you; both of you now appear in our catalogue, and appearances are never free.

civilizations.contact_line: Inheritance bankers whose board of directors has been dead for centuries — attendance remains perfect. Here, dying is simply a lateral move into senior management.
civilizations.hail: Our deepest condolences on your continued liquidity; the arrangement fee appears as line item one. The departed partners reviewed your portfolio at last evening's interment and have voted, unanimously, to acquire you. Please, take all the time you need — it accrues at the standard rate.

civilizations.contact_line: An entire species of influencers, monetizing the act of being watched. They filmed your arrival from six angles and tagged you in all of them.
civilizations.hail: OMG you guys, a whole NEW EMPIRE just dropped — link your assets in bio!! Smash that treaty button, ring the little bell, and surrender your attention before this offer stops trending. #FirstContact #Blessed

civilizations.contact_line: A bureaucracy so old the forms have outlived three civilizations, including the one that printed them. Take a number; eternity is running slightly behind.
civilizations.hail: Greetings, applicant. Your First Contact request (ФОРМА 88-Б, submitted in triplicate) has been received, stamped ОДОБРЕНО, and filed under PENDING — ВЕЧНО. Please join Queue 7,441-В; your commerce will be processed in the order in which it was inherited.

civilizations.contact_line: Cartographer-priests who copyrighted the concept of 'where.' Your empire has a location, and the location just received an invoice.
civilizations.hail: Hail, entity at declination -12° 40', right ascension 4h 33m, grid square OURS. We have completed the survey — bearing 090° true, north of your ambitions — and drawn a border around your fortune; you now lease the coordinates you are standing on. Payment is due wherever you are, which, per the master atlas, is everywhere we own.

civilizations.contact_line: Auditors of the universe's slow bankruptcy, they have shorted everything that exists and are always, eventually, right. Your empire has just been marked down as a rounding error on the way to zero.
civilizations.hail: Audit commenced. ∑(your holdings) = a positive number, which is a temporary condition; ΔS > 0, every margin → 0, and all accounts close at ∅. We have held a short position against your empire since before it existed — settlement is not a question of if, merely of when, and we are patient to the last kelvin.

civilizations.contact_line: They own the concept of ownership itself, which makes your entire empire, retroactively, a rental. Congratulations: you are now the universe's most successful tenant.
civilizations.hail: Welcome, hereinafter 'the Tenant', to Existence™ (see §1: 'All of It, Ours'). Your so-called Empire has been duly recorded as a Fixture (§4,088,209,317) and is hereby graciously sublet back to You at prevailing rates, plus Gratitude™. By continuing to exist, You accept these Terms.

design_pattern.economy: A continuous ~7x-per-rung cost/income ladder across all 137 properties. Earth (tier 1) has 12 property types; each alien epoch (tiers 2-26) INTRODUCES 5 new property types and continues the ladder.
design_pattern.economy_scale: Each epoch's clear threshold = earth_economy_target x 7^(5*(tier-1)) = x16807 per epoch. A new epoch's cheapest property costs ~10% of the previous epoch's threshold (a real save-up).
design_pattern.per_civilization: A distinct VOICE (the 'hail' = its own first words, in-character), a home planet, a flavor currency name, an accent color, a deadpan narrator 'contact_line', and a re-theming of EVERY property's staffer title into its theme.
design_pattern.tone: Wry, satirical late-capitalism humor; alien civilizations are money-obsessed in their own strange way (light beings, machines, fungal hive-minds, crystals, time-eaters).
design_pattern.v2_notes: Tiers 7-26 numbers computed from the same pattern: economy_scale = 16807^(tier-1); cheapest property of tier T = 10% of tier (T-1) clear threshold, x7 per rung; income = unit_cost x 0.01824 (values rounded to 4 significant figures); all alien cycles 60s. Roster order here is Earth's 12 then each tier's 5 in introduction order (the original export interleaved by rung). Some civs use non-Latin scripts in their hails (runes tier 10, Greek tier 16, mirrored text tier 20, Cyrillic tier 23, math notation tier 25) - file must stay UTF-8.
